capabilities: View code and data files with syntax highlighting
Open large files without lag using virtualization
Toggle line numbers, line wrapping, and copy snippets
Prevent accidental edits with read-only mode
disambiguation: Not a code editor; files are displayed in a read-only preview, with an edit toggle only for switching back.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README covers installation via the community directory, BRAT, or manual file placement, plus troubleshooting for syntax conflicts and read-only mode.
problem: Obsidian opens code and data files as raw editable text, which causes editing lag and risks accidental keystrokes modifying the files.

relations.evidence: While compatible with any theme, it is optimized to merge with the Zenith theme
Install the BRAT plugin from Obsidian's community store.

summary: Read-only viewer for code and data files (JSON, TypeScript, CSS, CSV, YAML) that adds syntax highlighting and lag-free rendering of large files.
